summary: This Casual Friday episode features Cred and Duck discussing Bitcoin's extended consolidation near all-time highs, which they note is historically unusual. Duck maintains a neutral-to-bullish stance on BTC with key support at 61-64k cluster and invalidation at 58k. They express frustration with the choppy market conditions, emphasizing that most traders are losing money in this environment. Ethereum is viewed bearishly with the ETF narrative considered failed, though Duck still holds a position expecting a potential narrative revival. Both hosts are dismissive of meme coins despite acknowledging their trading potential, preferring to wait for cleaner setups on major assets.
